description: Contract check schemas with binding targets for verification of PLAN.md contract sections

contract_checks.name: Limit Recovery

observed_fields.observable: The physical observable being tested in the limit
observed_fields.claim: The asserted limit behavior from PLAN.md

contract_checks.verification_method: Compute limit of deliverable using limiting_case_check.py; compare against claimed behavior; check acceptance_test threshold

contract_checks.name: Benchmark Reproduction

observed_fields.claim: The claimed benchmark value from PLAN.md

contract_checks.verification_method: Substitute numerical values from reference into deliverable; compare against claimed value within acceptance_test tolerance

contract_checks.name: Direct-Proxy Consistency

observed_fields.deliverable: Both direct and proxy computation results
observed_fields.forbidden_proxy: List of proxy types that must NOT be used as sole evidence

contract_checks.verification_method: Compare direct measurement against proxy; verify no forbidden proxy is sole evidence source; check acceptance_test criterion

contract_checks.name: Fit Family Mismatch

observed_fields.claim: The claimed fit family (e.g., power-law, exponential)
observed_fields.deliverable: The fit result and family used

contract_checks.verification_method: Compare deliverable's fit family against claimed family; test extrapolation behavior; verify acceptance_test

contract_checks.name: Estimator Family Mismatch

observed_fields.deliverable: The estimator result and bias analysis

contract_checks.verification_method: Compute estimator bias numerically; check against claimed properties; verify acceptance_test

contract_checks.name: Proof Hypothesis Coverage

observed_fields.claim: Set of hypotheses stated in the claim

contract_checks.verification_method: Enumerate all hypotheses from claim; verify each is addressed in deliverable; check acceptance_test completeness

contract_checks.name: Proof Parameter Coverage

observed_fields.claim: Parameter ranges stated in the claim

contract_checks.verification_method: Enumerate all parameter ranges from claim; verify each range is covered in deliverable; check acceptance_test

contract_checks.name: Proof Quantifier Domain

observed_fields.claim: Quantifier specifications (∀/∃ with domain) from claim

contract_checks.verification_method: Extract quantifier domains from claim; verify proof covers same domains; check acceptance_test

contract_checks.name: Claim-to-Proof Alignment
contract_checks.verification_method: Compare claim scope against proof scope; verify proof addresses exactly what claim asserts; check acceptance_test

contract_checks.name: Counterexample Search
contract_checks.verification_method: Systematically search for counterexamples using numerical spot-check at boundary values; verify no counterexample found within acceptance_test scope
